title: Komyo-ji — The Autumn Bell
description: A Japanese Buddhist mountain temple at the hour of the autumn bell: a three-storey pagoda, an irimoya-roofed worship hall with a golden altar, a suspended bonsho bell and an autumn maple reflected in the koi pond beneath the pilgrim bridge. Open verandas and winding stone approaches connect the buildings into one temple precinct.

sections.name: Pond stones, koi and fallen leaves
